P01.label: MIXED
P01.rationale: Author-nominated opening: 4 explanatory jobs (report run, judge text, assert repeatability, scope correctness) before the central result lands; correctness framing interrupts the run report.

P02.label: EXPO_COMPRESSION
P02.rationale: Clear 3-sentence setup; unit burden comes entirely from the embedded opening paragraph (P01). Flagged as a unit only by containment.

P03.label: EXPO_COMPRESSION
P03.rationale: Two distinct explanatory jobs concatenated: run report plus book-thesis taxonomy; the second redefines terms the first already used.

P04.label: NO_ISSUE
P04.rationale: Dense but parallel taxonomy: performance/quality/correctness each get their own sentence plus matched failure modes. Deliberate, skimmable structure.

P05.label: NO_ISSUE
P05.rationale: Thesis paragraph plus an ordinary roadmap sentence; no obstruction.

P06.label: NO_ISSUE
P06.rationale: Roadmap plus series inventory; dense by necessity with one clause per volume.

P07.label: UNCERTAIN
P07.rationale: Rich series-context paragraph: contribution, returns, and dependents in one unit. Possibly overloaded for new readers, fine for series followers.

P08.label: UNCERTAIN
P08.rationale: Same paragraph as P07 second half standalone; same context-dependence.

P09.label: NO_ISSUE
P09.rationale: Clear framing paragraph plus a one-sentence section intro; no obstruction.

P10.label: NO_ISSUE
P10.rationale: Qualifications ordered after the claim (probe, then preflight-vs-qualified); each earns its place.

P11.label: NO_ISSUE
P11.rationale: Enumerated pipeline steps, not prose burden.

P12.label: NO_ISSUE
P12.rationale: Same series-inventory paragraph as in P06; one clause per volume.

P13.label: NO_ISSUE
P13.rationale: Concrete toy-fixture paragraph with explicit scope limits; lead-in sentence points forward clearly.

P14.label: NO_ISSUE
P14.rationale: Parallel taxonomy of three surrogate kinds, each defined in place.

P15.label: NO_ISSUE
P15.rationale: Concrete example with explicit scope limits; short and ordered.

P16.label: EXPO_COMPRESSION
P16.rationale: Two 7-stage enumerations (toy vs real path) plus exceptions and an alignment warning in one paragraph; reader must hold both lists to get the warning.

P17.label: NO_ISSUE
P17.rationale: Math plus two plain sentences; forward pointer is clear.

P18.label: NO_ISSUE
P18.rationale: Two parallel instructions with clear scope.

P19.label: NO_ISSUE
P19.rationale: Concrete pointer to code; abstractions named rather than explained all at once.

P20.label: NO_ISSUE
P20.rationale: Borderline dense comparison paragraph rescued by the concrete code pointer that follows; acceptable as a unit.

P21.label: UNCERTAIN
P21.rationale: Thesis sentence packs four book jobs (cheaper, less wasteful, sharing, measuring); may be too much or a fine roadmap.

P22.label: NO_ISSUE
P22.rationale: Same parallel taxonomy as P14 with its lead-in; each item defined in place.

P23.label: EXPO_COMPRESSION
P23.rationale: Eight-item experiment inventory plus seeding rule plus interpretation caveat in three sentences.

P24.label: UNCERTAIN
P24.rationale: Terse telegraphic style: three code changes in two sentences. Each names its fix, but barely.

P25.label: NO_ISSUE
P25.rationale: Distinction introduced before its contrast (contract, use-case, serving contrast, consequence); one job per sentence.

P26.label: UNCERTAIN
P26.rationale: Precise but heavy qualification chain ending in a forbid-claim-even-when construction; possibly necessary precision, needs a reader test.

P27.label: NO_ISSUE
P27.rationale: Crisp purpose paragraph: examples then success criterion then boundary. Ordered well.

P28.label: NO_ISSUE
P28.rationale: Classic three-level taxonomy, one sentence per level, scope stated.

P29.label: UNCERTAIN
P29.rationale: Packs interface examples, reader rights, and a correction rule; possibly overloaded.

P30.label: EXPO_COMPRESSION
P30.rationale: Four ideas in one unit: two system kinds, a cited finding, a symptom, and a restated limitation.

P31.label: NO_ISSUE

P32.label: NO_ISSUE
